input.description: That tool's input — same shape you'd pass when calling it directly. For computer items whose action is left_click, right_click, double_click, triple_click, left_click_drag, key or type, and for form_input items, include action_summary in the item's input, as you would when calling that tool directly.

actions.description: List of tool calls to execute sequentially. Example: [{"name":"computer","input":{"action":"left_click","ref":"ref_12"}},{"name":"computer","input":{"action":"type","text":"hello"}},{"name":"computer","input":{"action":"screenshot"}}]

tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__computer
tools.description: Mouse/keyboard automation in the Browser pane. Clicks accept either `coordinate` (pixels in the coordinate frame of the most recent `computer{action:"screenshot"}` — reported with every scaled screenshot; equal to the image's pixels for unscaled ones) or `ref` (a `ref_N` from read_page/find). Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a screenshot to determine the coordinates of the element first; after the tab loads a different site, take a new screenshot before clicking by `coordinate`.

schema.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__computer
schema.description: Mouse/keyboard automation in the Browser pane. Clicks accept either `coordinate` (pixels in the coordinate frame of the most recent `computer{action:"screenshot"}` — reported with every scaled screenshot; equal to the image's pixels for unscaled ones) or `ref` (a `ref_N` from read_page/find). Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a screenshot to determine the coordinates of the element first; after the tab loads a different site, take a new screenshot before clicking by `coordinate`.

tabId.description: Tab to act on within the preview context. Omit for the fronted tab; get ids from tabs_context.

action.description:
The action to perform:
* `left_click`: Click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `right_click`: Click the right mouse button at the specified coordinates to open context menus.
* `double_click`: Double-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `triple_click`: Triple-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `type`: Type a string of text.
* `screenshot`: Take a screenshot of the screen.
* `wait`: Wait for a specified number of seconds.
* `scroll`: Scroll up, down, left, or right at the specified coordinates.
* `key`: Press a specific keyboard key.
* `left_click_drag`: Drag from start_coordinate to coordinate.
* `zoom`: Take a screenshot of a specific region for closer inspection.
* `scroll_to`: Scroll an element into view using its element reference ID from read_page or find tools.
* `hover`: Move the mouse cursor to the specified coordinates or element without clicking. Useful for revealing tooltips, dropdown menus, or triggering hover states.

coordinate.description: (x, y): The x (pixels from the left edge) and y (pixels from the top edge) coordinates. Required for `left_click`, `right_click`, `double_click`, `triple_click`, and `scroll`. For `left_click_drag`, this is the end position.

text.description: The text to type (for `type` action) or the key(s) to press (for `key` action). For `key` action: Provide space-separated keys (e.g., "Backspace Backspace Delete"). Supports keyboard shortcuts using the platform's modifier key (use "cmd" on Mac, "ctrl" on Windows/Linux, e.g., "cmd+a" or "ctrl+a" for select all). Page zoom shortcuts (e.g. "cmd+=", "ctrl+-", "cmd+0") are not supported - use the `zoom` action to magnify a region of the page instead.

duration.description: The number of seconds to wait. Required for `wait`. Maximum 10 seconds.

scroll_direction.description: The direction to scroll. Required for `scroll`.

scroll_amount.description: The number of scroll wheel ticks. Optional for `scroll`, defaults to 3.

region.description: (x0, y0, x1, y1): The rectangular region to capture for `zoom`. Coordinates define a rectangle from top-left (x0, y0) to bottom-right (x1, y1) in pixels from the viewport origin. Required for `zoom` action. Useful for inspecting small UI elements like icons, buttons, or text.

scale.description: For `screenshot` and `zoom` only. Scale factor in [0.1, 1] for the returned image; 1 (default) uses the full image token budget, 0.5 returns an image at half the width and height (~quarter of the tokens). Coordinates are ALWAYS in the full-resolution coordinate frame (reported with every scaled screenshot), never in the scaled image's own pixels.

repeat.description: Number of times to repeat the key sequence. Only applicable for `key` action. Must be a positive integer between 1 and 100. Default is 1. Useful for navigation tasks like pressing arrow keys multiple times.

ref.description: Element reference ID from read_page or find tools (e.g., "ref_1", "ref_2"). Required for `scroll_to` action. Can be used as alternative to `coordinate` for click actions.

modifiers.description: Modifier keys for click actions. Supports: "ctrl", "shift", "alt", "cmd" (or "meta"), "win" (or "windows"). Can be combined with "+" (e.g., "ctrl+shift", "cmd+alt"). Optional.

action_summary.description: A few words saying what this action does on the page and to what, for example 'Sends the drafted reply to pat@example.com' or 'Opens the Filters menu'. Set it on every left_click, right_click, double_click, triple_click, left_click_drag, key and type action. State the effect only, and accurately: no reasons, nothing about what you were asked or allowed to do, no passwords or other secrets.

'attach' opens a live panel so the user can watch — when the user wants to see the app, call 'attach' FIRST, before building: it is cheap, opens instantly on a booted simulator, and errors harmlessly when nothing is booted (boot or build, then retry it). action.description: What to do. 'attach' opens the live simulator panel for the user — call it BEFORE you build or launch, as soon as the user wants to see the app: on a booted simulator it opens immediately, and otherwise it returns a clear, harmless error (boot or build first, then retry it). Do not skip the early attach because 'launch' also attaches — the panel should be open before the build starts. The panel is the user's view, not a precondition — 'screenshot' and input actions work without it. Skip it only when the user has no interest in watching; 'launch' installs and launches an .app (it also re-attaches, but call 'attach' early rather than relying on that); 'screenshot' returns a PNG of the current screen; 'tap'/'swipe'/'text'/'button' inject input; 'press_key' presses a hardware key 'count' times: return, delete (backspace), an arrow, select_all, undo or redo (a key also hides the on-screen keyboard); 'set_appearance' switches the device to light or dark mode; 'appearance' says which it is in; 'set_keyboard' shows or hides the on-screen keyboard (it appears only while a text field has focus, and 'press_key' and 'text' hide it again); 'rotate' turns the device a quarter turn left or right ('direction'); take a 'screenshot' after it and tap in that screenshot's frame, however it comes back; 'touch_path' performs a single-finger drag along an arbitrary path (eased curves, long-press-then-drag); 'touch2_path' is the two-finger variant for pinch/rotate; 'open_url' opens a deep link; 'detach' closes the panel/stream. NOTE: a 'swipe' or 'touch_path' whose start point is on-screen and within 4pt of an edge performs the OS edge gesture instead of a plain drag — left=back, top=notification shade, bottom=home/app-switcher, right=Control Center (mapped to the current interface orientation). Start more than 4pt from the edge to drag or scroll content near the bezel.

app_path.description: For 'launch': absolute path (no ~) to the built .app bundle (e.g. /Users/me/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData/MyApp-abc123/Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/MyApp.app).

device.description: Simulator name (e.g. 'iPhone 17 Pro') or UDID. Defaults to the simulator already attached, else the first booted one. The first use of a device asks the user for permission.

udid.description: Alias for 'device' (identical semantics: simulator name or UDID). Pass at most one of 'device' / 'udid'.

bundle_id.description: For 'launch': bundle identifier. If omitted, extracted from the .app's Info.plist.

points.description: For 'touch_path': touch path samples in device points. First point is touch-down; last is touch-up. dt_ms is the delay before that sample (0-1000 ms; the first sample's is skipped, so send 0 or omit it; at most 30 seconds in all).

points2.description: For 'touch2_path': two-finger path samples in device points. Each sample carries both contacts (x1/y1, x2/y2); first is touch-down, last is touch-up. dt_ms is the delay before that sample (0-1000 ms; the first sample's is skipped, so send 0 or omit it; at most 30 seconds in all).

duration.description: Seconds. For 'tap', >0.5 is a long-press. For 'swipe', the gesture duration (default 0.3).

key.description: For 'press_key': the key or edit command to press.

count.description: For 'press_key': how many times to press it, 1 to 20 (default 1).

state.description: For 'set_keyboard': 'show' or 'hide' the on-screen keyboard. For 'set_appearance': 'light' or 'dark'.

url.description: For 'open_url': URL or scheme to open in the simulator.

loading_messages.description: 1–4 loading messages shown to the user while the visual renders, each roughly 5 words long. Write them in the same language the user is using. Use 1 for simple visuals, more for complex ones. If the topic is serious — illness, disease, pandemics, death, grief, war, conflict, poverty, disaster, trauma, abuse, addiction, medical decisions, politically charged subjects, or anything where the reader might be personally affected — keep these BORING: describe what the code is doing in the dullest generic way, no jargon-as-drama, no evocative terms. Pandemic growth model — NOT ['Simulating patient zero', 'Modeling the curve'] (documentary-narrator voice), YES ['Setting up the model', 'Running the calculation']. Cancer timeline — NOT ['Charting the battle ahead'], YES ['Laying out the stages']. If you have to ask whether it's serious, it is. Otherwise, have fun — reach for alliteration, puns, personification, wordplay, whatever lands in that language. Playful examples — revenue chart: ['Bribing bars to stand taller', 'Asking Q4 where it went']; kanban: ['Herding cards into columns', 'Dragging, dropping, not stopping'].

title.description: Short snake_case identifier for this visual. Must be specific and disambiguating — if the conversation has multiple visuals, this title alone should tell you which one is being referenced (e.g. 'q4_revenue_by_product_line' not 'chart', 'oauth_login_flow' not 'diagram'). Also used as the download filename, so no spaces or special characters.

widget_code.description: SVG or HTML code to render. For SVG: raw SVG code starting with <svg> tag, must use CSS variables for colors. Example: <svg viewBox="0 0 700 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">...</svg>. For HTML: raw HTML content to render, do NOT include DOCTYPE, <html>, <head>, or <body> tags. Use CSS variables for theming. Keep background transparent and avoid top-level padding. Scripts are supported but execute after streaming completes.

1	import Ern.MemoryModel.Arena
2	import Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement
3	
4	/-!
5	# DataStack: a library administrative abstraction (contract DS-v1, non-normative)
6	
7	A `DataStack` instance of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.md`. The spec does not define
8	its contract (Part XIV preamble: "The contracts of `HandlePool` and `DataStack` belong to their
9	library abstractions and are not defined here"). The contract formalized here is the library
10	contract **DS-v1**, which is **not normative**: every definition below that encodes a DS-v1 item
11	says so. The normative clauses that constrain it are §36 (`MetaRight` requires `Modify` exercisable
12	on the stack value; the abstraction adds no rights to the kernel), §38 and §46 (library state
13	separate from `S₃`), §47 (empty initial registry), §56 (guard over all registries of live
14	administrations) and §58 (outcomes).
15	
16	DS-v1: marks carry the stack identity and a fresh mark identifier; the stack keeps the ordered list
17	of live marks; `rewind m` fails on a dead or foreign mark, rejects if an active authority derived
18	from `internal` covers a cell above `m`, otherwise returns those cells to available and removes `m`
19	and every mark above it; `push` and `grow` use the derived `issue` of Part XIV (`Arena.IssueD`: its
20	static checks, the availability `fail`, then `split` of `internal` and `store` of the block); `grow`
21	is in place only (same base, extension into the space directly after the block, `fail` otherwise).
22	
23	Every `ok` step of the library is a sequence of kernel steps O1–O16 (`DReach.reachable`), so the
24	abstraction adds no rights to the kernel (§36).
25	-/
26	
27	namespace Ern.Lib.DataStack
28	
29	open Ern.MemoryModel Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.MemoryModel.Arena
30	
31	/-! ## Library state (DS-v1; §38, §46, §47) -/
32	
33	/-- A block issued by a stack (DS-v1, non-normative; recorded like the issuances of §46): position
34	`base` of its first cell and number `size` of cells among the ordered cells of the stack, block
35	authority `auth`, destination `dst` that received it. -/
36	structure Blk where
37	  base : Nat
38	  size : Nat
39	  auth : Nat
40	  dst : Nat
41	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
42	
43	/-- A mark (DS-v1, non-normative: "marks carry stack identity and a fresh mark identifier";
44	library metadata of an administrative abstraction, §36, §38): the identity of its stack, its fresh
45	identifier, the top of the stack when it was taken. -/
46	structure Mark where
47	  stack : Nat
48	  id : Nat
49	  top : Nat
50	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
51	
52	/-- A stack (DS-v1, non-normative; library state, §38, §46): administered storage, `internal`
53	authority held by the stack value (§36), ordered cells (the leaves of the storage at creation),
54	top (the cells at positions `≥ top` are available), issued blocks (oldest first), and the ordered
55	list of live marks (DS-v1: "the stack keeps the ordered list of live marks"). -/
56	structure Stack where
57	  storage : Nat
58	  internal : Nat
59	  cells : List Nat
60	  top : Nat
61	  blocks : List Blk
62	  marks : List Mark
63	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
64	
65	/-- State of the stack library (DS-v1, non-normative; §38: administrative states of library
66	abstractions are separate from `S₃`): the kernel state, the stack registry (a stack is identified
67	by its index; stacks are never removed) and the next fresh mark identifier. -/
68	structure DState where
69	  kern : S3
70	  stacks : List Stack
71	  fresh : Nat
72	
73	/-- Initial state (§47: the kernel's initial state; the library registry starts empty; DS-v1,
74	non-normative: no mark identifier given out). -/
75	def DState.init (statics : Statics) : DState := ⟨S3.init statics, [], 0⟩
76	
77	/-- The `n` cells from position `b` of the stack, leaves of the administered storage (§46; DS-v1,
78	non-normative). -/
79	def cellsOf (st : Stack) (b n : Nat) : List Nat := (st.cells.drop b).take n
80	
81	/-- The cells above mark `m` (DS-v1, non-normative, "a cell above m"; reading recorded; §46
82	available leaves): the positions from the top of `m` to the current top, those that `rewind m`
83	returns to available. -/
84	def above (st : Stack) (m : Mark) : List Nat := cellsOf st m.top (st.top - m.top)
85	
86	/-- The stack seen as an administration entry (§46, §36; DS-v1, non-normative): storage,
87	`internal`, available cells (positions `≥ top`) and issued blocks. Used for `MetaRight` and the
88	static checks of the derived `issue`, which read only the storage and `internal`. -/
89	def Stack.entry (st : Stack) : ArenaEntry :=
90	  ⟨st.storage, st.internal, st.cells.drop st.top,
91	    st.blocks.map fun x => (cellsOf st x.base x.size, x.auth)⟩
92	
93	/-- The block of the stack whose authority is `b` (§46 issuances; DS-v1, non-normative). -/
94	def Stack.block (st : Stack) (b : Nat) : Option Blk := st.blocks.find? fun y => decide (y.auth = b)
95	
96	/-- A live mark of stack `j` (DS-v1, non-normative: a mark that is neither dead nor foreign; it
97	decides the `fail` case of `rewind`, §58): it names stack `j` and belongs to its list of live
98	marks. -/
99	def LiveMark (j : Nat) (st : Stack) (m : Mark) : Prop := m.stack = j ∧ m ∈ st.marks
100	
101	/-- Decidability of `LiveMark` (§58; DS-v1). -/
102	instance (j : Nat) (st : Stack) (m : Mark) : Decidable (LiveMark j st m) := by
103	  unfold LiveMark; infer_instance
104	
105	/-- The administrative right of §36 for a stack (DS-v1, non-normative, with §36 and §46 read for a
106	stack): the stack is live (`internal` is active) and `MetaRight`, `Modify` exercisable on the stack
107	value, the place holding `internal`. -/
108	def AdminRight (s : S3) (st : Stack) : Prop := s.Active st.internal ∧ MetaRight s st.entry
109	
110	/-- Decidability of `AdminRight` (§36; DS-v1). -/
111	instance (s : S3) (st : Stack) : Decidable (AdminRight s st) := by
112	  unfold AdminRight; infer_instance
113	
114	/-! ## `newStack` and the guard of §56 -/
115	
116	/-- The stack registry as a registry of live administrations (§56; DS-v1, non-normative): the
117	`internal` identities of its live stacks. -/
118	def stackInternals (s : S3) (stacks : List Stack) : List Nat :=
119	  (stacks.filter fun st => decide (s.Active st.internal)).map (·.internal)
120	
121	/-- Preconditions of `newStack(storage, internal)` (DS-v1, non-normative; §56): those of `newArena`
122	other than its guard (`NewArenaBase`, §76.1–§76.3 and §76.5 read for a stack), and the guard of §56
123	over the stack registry and every other registry of live administrations `others`. -/
124	structure NewStackPre (s : S3) (stacks : List Stack) (others : List (List Nat))
125	    (storage internal : Nat) : Prop where
126	  /-- §76.1–§76.3, §76.5, read for a stack (DS-v1). -/
127	  base : NewArenaBase s storage internal
128	  /-- §56: no live administration of any registry uses `internal`. -/
129	  guard : Guard56 (stackInternals s stacks :: others) internal
130	
131	/-- Decidability of `NewStackPre` (§56; DS-v1). -/
132	instance (s : S3) (stacks : List Stack) (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) :
133	    Decidable (NewStackPre s stacks others storage internal) :=
134	  decidable_of_iff (NewArenaBase s storage internal ∧
135	    Guard56 (stackInternals s stacks :: others) internal)
136	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩⟩
137	
138	/-- Effect of `newStack` (DS-v1, non-normative; §36: registration adds no rights): a stack whose
139	cells are the leaves of the storage, top 0, no block, no mark; the kernel state is unchanged. -/
140	def newStackEff (D : DState) (storage internal : Nat) : DState :=
141	  { D with stacks := D.stacks ++ [⟨storage, internal, footprint D.kern.P storage, 0, [], []⟩] }
142	
143	/-- `newStack` as a relation (DS-v1, non-normative; §56, §58): `ok` or `reject`. -/
144	def NewStackStep (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) (D : DState) :
145	    Outcome3 DState → Prop :=
146	  Guarded (NewStackPre D.kern D.stacks others storage internal) (newStackEff D storage internal)
147	
148	/-! ## `push` (DS-v1: the derived `issue`, Part XIV, §77) -/
149	
150	/-- Metadata after `push` (DS-v1, non-normative; as the `ok` effect of §77 on §46 metadata): the
151	cells leave the available part (the top rises by `size`), the block is recorded. -/
152	def pushMeta (st : Stack) (size a dst : Nat) : Stack :=
153	  { st with top := st.top + size, blocks := st.blocks ++ [⟨st.top, size, a, dst⟩] }
154	
155	/-- `push(j, size, dst)` (DS-v1, non-normative: "push uses the derived issue"): the derived `issue`
156	of Part XIV (`Arena.IssueD`) of the `size` cells at the top into `dst`, on the stack seen as an
157	entry: its static checks (`IssueStatic`, §77.1, §77.2, with `MetaRight` of §36), then `fail`, the
158	state unchanged, when fewer than `size` cells are left (availability, §77.4; reading recorded),
159	then `split` of `internal` on the cells (O2) and `store` of the block, of fresh identity `|A|`, into
160	`dst` (O8). -/
161	inductive PushStep (k : K) (j size dst : Nat) (D : DState) : Outcome3 DState → Prop where
162	  | noStack : D.stacks[j]? = none → PushStep k j size dst D .reject
163	  | static {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
164	      ¬ IssueStatic D.kern st.entry (cellsOf st st.top size) dst → PushStep k j size dst D .reject
165	  | fail {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
166	      IssueStatic D.kern st.entry (cellsOf st st.top size) dst →
167	      ¬ st.top + size ≤ st.cells.length → PushStep k j size dst D .fail
168	  | split {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
169	      IssueStatic D.kern st.entry (cellsOf st st.top size) dst →
170	      st.top + size ≤ st.cells.length →
171	      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st st.top size] D.kern .reject →
172	      PushStep k j size dst D .reject
173	  | store {st : Stack} {s₁ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
174	      IssueStatic D.kern st.entry (cellsOf st st.top size) dst →
175	      st.top + size ≤ st.cells.length →
176	      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st st.top size] D.kern (.ok s₁) →
177	      StoreStep D.kern.A.length dst s₁ .reject → PushStep k j size dst D .reject
178	  | ok {st : Stack} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
179	      IssueStatic D.kern st.entry (cellsOf st st.top size) dst →
180	      st.top + size ≤ st.cells.length →
181	      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st st.top size] D.kern (.ok s₁) →
182	      StoreStep D.kern.A.length dst s₁ (.ok s₂) →
183	      PushStep k j size dst D
184	        (.ok ⟨s₂, D.stacks.set j (pushMeta st size D.kern.A.length dst), D.fresh⟩)
185	
186	/-! ## `mark` (DS-v1) -/
187	
188	/-- Metadata after `mark` (DS-v1, non-normative; library metadata, §36, §38): a mark naming stack
189	`j`, with the fresh identifier `fresh` and the current top, is appended to the live marks. -/
190	def markMeta (j : Nat) (st : Stack) (fresh : Nat) : Stack :=
191	  { st with marks := st.marks ++ [⟨j, fresh, st.top⟩] }
192	
193	/-- `mark(j)` (DS-v1, non-normative; §58 outcomes; §36: metadata only, no right created): `ok`
194	on an existing stack; the identifier is fresh. -/
195	inductive MarkStep (j : Nat) (D : DState) : Outcome3 DState → Prop where
196	  | noStack : D.stacks[j]? = none → MarkStep j D .reject
197	  | ok {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
198	      MarkStep j D (.ok ⟨D.kern, D.stacks.set j (markMeta j st D.fresh), D.fresh + 1⟩)
199	
200	/-! ## `rewind` (DS-v1) -/
201	
202	/-- Metadata after `rewind m` (DS-v1, non-normative; as the `ok` effect of §78 on §46 metadata):
203	the cells above `m` return to available (the top returns to the top of `m`), the blocks from that
204	top are forgotten, `m` and every later mark are removed. -/
205	def rewindMeta (st : Stack) (m : Mark) : Stack :=
206	  { st with
207	    top := m.top
208	    blocks := st.blocks.filter fun x => decide (x.base < m.top)
209	    marks := st.marks.takeWhile fun x => decide (x ≠ m) }
210	
211	/-- `rewind(j, m)` (DS-v1, non-normative): `fail`, the state unchanged, on a dead or foreign mark;
212	`reject` without the administrative right of §36; then the derived `reset` of Part XIV on the cells
213	above `m` (reading recorded): `split` of `internal` on them (O2), which rejects when an active
214	authority derived from `internal` covers one of them (`rewind_rejects_live_above`), and `release`
215	of the derived authority (O3); `ok`: the cells return to available, `m` and the later marks are
216	removed. -/
217	inductive RewindStep (k : K) (j : Nat) (m : Mark) (D : DState) : Outcome3 DState → Prop where
218	  | noStack : D.stacks[j]? = none → RewindStep k j m D .reject
219	  | dead {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → ¬ LiveMark j st m → RewindStep k j m D .fail
220	  | static {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → LiveMark j st m → ¬ AdminRight D.kern st →
221	      RewindStep k j m D .reject
222	  | split {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → LiveMark j st m → AdminRight D.kern st →
223	      SplitStep k st.internal [above st m] D.kern .reject → RewindStep k j m D .reject
224	  | release {st : Stack} {s₁ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → LiveMark j st m →
225	      AdminRight D.kern st → SplitStep k st.internal [above st m] D.kern (.ok s₁) →
226	      ReleaseStep D.kern.A.length s₁ .reject → RewindStep k j m D .reject
227	  | ok {st : Stack} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → LiveMark j st m →
228	      AdminRight D.kern st → SplitStep k st.internal [above st m] D.kern (.ok s₁) →
229	      ReleaseStep D.kern.A.length s₁ (.ok s₂) →
230	      RewindStep k j m D (.ok ⟨s₂, D.stacks.set j (rewindMeta st m), D.fresh⟩)
231	
232	/-! ## `grow` (DS-v1: in place, the derived `issue`) -/
233	
234	/-- In-place extension (DS-v1, non-normative: "extension into the space directly after the
235	block"; the availability check of the derived `issue`, §77.4): the block ends at the top, and
236	`extra` available cells follow it. -/
237	def InPlace (st : Stack) (x : Blk) (extra : Nat) : Prop :=
238	  x.base + x.size = st.top ∧ st.top + extra ≤ st.cells.length
239	
240	/-- Decidability of `InPlace` (§77.4; DS-v1). -/
241	instance (st : Stack) (x : Blk) (extra : Nat) : Decidable (InPlace st x extra) := by
242	  unfold InPlace; infer_instance
243	
244	/-- The grown block (DS-v1, non-normative: same base, `extra` more cells, new authority `a`, same
245	destination; an issuance of §46). -/
246	def growBlk (x : Blk) (extra a : Nat) : Blk := ⟨x.base, x.size + extra, a, x.dst⟩
247	
248	/-- Metadata after `grow` (DS-v1, non-normative; as the `ok` effect of §77 on §46 metadata): the
249	top rises by `extra`; the block is replaced by the grown block. -/
250	def growMeta (st : Stack) (x : Blk) (extra a : Nat) : Stack :=
251	  { st with
252	    top := st.top + extra
253	    blocks := st.blocks.map fun y => if y.auth = x.auth then growBlk x extra a else y }
254	
255	/-- `grow(j, b, extra)` (DS-v1, non-normative: in place only, using the derived `issue`): `reject`
256	when `b` is not a block of the stack or `extra` is zero (reading recorded); `release` of `b` (O3);
257	then the derived `issue` of Part XIV (`Arena.IssueD`) of the region of the same base and of size
258	`size + extra` into the recorded destination, on the released state: its static checks
259	(`IssueStatic`, §77.1, §77.2), `fail`, the state unchanged, unless the extension is in place
260	(DS-v1 "fail otherwise", availability §77.4), `split` of `internal` (O2) and `store` of the new
261	block (O8). -/
262	inductive GrowStep (k : K) (j b extra : Nat) (D : DState) : Outcome3 DState → Prop where
263	  | noStack : D.stacks[j]? = none → GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
264	  | noBlock {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = none →
265	      GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
266	  | noExtra {st : Stack} {x : Blk} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x → extra = 0 →
267	      GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
268	  | release {st : Stack} {x : Blk} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x → 0 < extra →
269	      ReleaseStep b D.kern .reject → GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
270	  | static {st : Stack} {x : Blk} {s₁ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x →
271	      0 < extra → ReleaseStep b D.kern (.ok s₁) →
272	      ¬ IssueStatic s₁ st.entry (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) x.dst →
273	      GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
274	  | fail {st : Stack} {x : Blk} {s₁ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x →
275	      0 < extra → ReleaseStep b D.kern (.ok s₁) →
276	      IssueStatic s₁ st.entry (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) x.dst →
277	      ¬ InPlace st x extra → GrowStep k j b extra D .fail
278	  | split {st : Stack} {x : Blk} {s₁ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x →
279	      0 < extra → ReleaseStep b D.kern (.ok s₁) →
280	      IssueStatic s₁ st.entry (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) x.dst → InPlace st x extra →
281	      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)] s₁ .reject →
282	      GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
283	  | store {st : Stack} {x : Blk} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x →
284	      0 < extra → ReleaseStep b D.kern (.ok s₁) →
285	      IssueStatic s₁ st.entry (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) x.dst → InPlace st x extra →
286	      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)] s₁ (.ok s₂) →
287	      StoreStep s₁.A.length x.dst s₂ .reject → GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
288	  | ok {st : Stack} {x : Blk} {s₁ s₂ s₃ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x →
289	      0 < extra → ReleaseStep b D.kern (.ok s₁) →
290	      IssueStatic s₁ st.entry (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) x.dst → InPlace st x extra →
291	      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)] s₁ (.ok s₂) →
292	      StoreStep s₁.A.length x.dst s₂ (.ok s₃) →
293	      GrowStep k j b extra D (.ok ⟨s₃, D.stacks.set j (growMeta st x extra s₁.A.length), D.fresh⟩)
294	
295	/-! ## Library runs (DS-v1; §36, §56, §57) -/
296	
297	/-- One `ok` step of the stack library (DS-v1, non-normative): a kernel step O1–O16 of
298	non-administrative code, the registry unchanged; `newStack` with the guard of §56 against the other
299	registries `others`; `push`, `mark`, `rewind`, `grow`. -/
300	inductive DStep (k : K) : DState → DState → Prop where
301	  | kernel {D : DState} {s' : S3} : KStep k D.kern s' → DStep k D ⟨s', D.stacks, D.fresh⟩
302	  | newStack {D D' : DState} {others : List (List Nat)} {storage i : Nat} :
303	      NewStackStep others storage i D (.ok D') → DStep k D D'
304	  | push {D D' : DState} {j size dst : Nat} : PushStep k j size dst D (.ok D') → DStep k D D'
305	  | mark {D D' : DState} {j : Nat} : MarkStep j D (.ok D') → DStep k D D'
306	  | rewind {D D' : DState} {j : Nat} {m : Mark} : RewindStep k j m D (.ok D') → DStep k D D'
307	  | grow {D D' : DState} {j b extra : Nat} : GrowStep k j b extra D (.ok D') → DStep k D D'
308	
309	/-- States reachable from the initial state by library steps (DS-v1, non-normative; §47). -/
310	inductive DReach (k : K) (statics : Statics) : DState → Prop where
311	  | init : DReach k statics (DState.init statics)
312	  | step {D D' : DState} : DReach k statics D → DStep k D D' → DReach k statics D'
313	
314	/-- Finite sequences of library steps (DS-v1, non-normative; §58 `ok` transitions). -/
315	inductive DRun (k : K) : DState → DState → Prop where
316	  | refl (D : DState) : DRun k D D
317	  | tail {D D' D'' : DState} : DRun k D D' → DStep k D' D'' → DRun k D D''
318	
319	/-- The kernel part of a library step is reached by kernel steps (§36: the abstraction adds no
320	rights to the kernel; Part XIV: `issue` is `split` then `store`, the reset part of `rewind` is
321	`split` then `release`; DS-v1). -/
322	theorem DStep.reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {D D' : DState}
323	    (hr : Reachable k statics D.kern) (h : DStep k D D') : Reachable k statics D'.kern := by
324	  cases h with
325	  | kernel hk => exact .step hr hk
326	  | newStack hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact hr
327	  | push hs =>
328	    cases hs with
329	    | ok _ _ _ hsp hst => exact .step (.step hr (.split hsp)) (.store hst)
330	  | mark hs => cases hs with | ok _ => exact hr
331	  | rewind hs =>
332	    cases hs with
333	    | ok _ _ _ hsp hrl => exact .step (.step hr (.split hsp)) (.release hrl)
334	  | grow hs =>
335	    cases hs with
336	    | ok _ _ _ hrl _ _ hsp hst =>
337	      exact .step (.step (.step hr (.release hrl)) (.split hsp)) (.store hst)
338	
339	/-- The kernel state of every library-reachable state is kernel-reachable (§36, §57; DS-v1). -/
340	theorem DReach.reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {D : DState} (h : DReach k statics D) :
341	    Reachable k statics D.kern := by
342	  induction h with
343	  | init => exact .init
344	  | step _ hs ih => exact hs.reachable ih
345	
346	/-! ## Helper lemmas (lists, kernel effects) -/
347	
348	/-- Reading a list after `set` (support for the §46 metadata updates of DS-v1). -/
349	theorem getElem?_set_cases {α : Type} {l : List α} {j i : Nat} {v x : α}
350	    (h : (l.set j v)[i]? = some x) : (i = j ∧ x = v) ∨ (i ≠ j ∧ l[i]? = some x) := by
351	  rw [List.getElem?_set] at h
352	  by_cases hij : j = i
353	  · subst hij; simp only [↓reduceIte] at h; split at h
354	    · cases h; exact .inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
355	    · cases h
356	  · simp only [hij, ↓reduceIte] at h; exact .inr ⟨Ne.symm hij, h⟩
357	
358	/-- Reading a list after appending one element (support for the §46 metadata updates of
359	DS-v1). -/
360	theorem getElem?_append_single {α : Type} {l : List α} {x y : α} {i : Nat}
361	    (h : (l ++ [x])[i]? = some y) : l[i]? = some y ∨ y = x := by
362	  rw [List.getElem?_append] at h
363	  split at h
364	  · exact .inl h
365	  · cases hc : i - l.length with
366	    | zero => rw [hc] at h; simp at h; exact .inr h.symm
367	    | succ n => rw [hc] at h; simp at h
368	
369	/-- `takeWhile (· ≠ m)` stops at the first occurrence of `m` (support for the §46 metadata of
370	DS-v1 `rewind`). -/
371	theorem takeWhile_ne_append {m : Mark} : ∀ {pre : List Mark} (post : List Mark), m ∉ pre →
372	    (pre ++ m :: post).takeWhile (fun x => decide (x ≠ m)) = pre
373	  | [], post, _ => by simp
374	  | a :: pre, post, h => by
375	    have ha : a ≠ m := fun e => h (e ▸ List.mem_cons_self ..)
376	    have ih := takeWhile_ne_append (pre := pre) post (fun h' => h (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h'))
377	    rw [List.cons_append, List.takeWhile_cons]
378	    simp only [ha, ne_eq, not_false_eq_true, decide_true, ↓reduceIte, ih]
379	
380	/-- A prefix of `take` (support for DS-v1 `grow`, §46 metadata: the old cells are a prefix of the
381	new ones). -/

507	  | kernel => exact hw
508	  | newStack hs =>
509	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
510	    intro i st h
511	    rcases getElem?_append_single h with h | rfl
512	    · exact hw i st h
513	    · exact ⟨List.nodup_nil, fun m hm => by simp at hm⟩

515	    cases hs with
516	    | ok hst => exact marksWF_set hw hst rfl (List.Sublist.refl _) (Nat.le_refl _)

518	    cases hs with
519	    | ok hst => exact marksWF_set hw hst rfl (List.takeWhile_sublist _) (Nat.le_refl _)

9	library abstractions and are not defined here"). The contract formalized here is the library
10	contract **DS-v1**, which is **not normative**: every definition below that encodes a DS-v1 item
11	says so. The normative clauses that constrain it are §36 (`MetaRight` requires `Modify` exercisable
12	on the stack value; the abstraction adds no rights to the kernel), §38 and §46 (library state
13	separate from `S₃`), §47 (empty initial registry), §56 (guard over all registries of live
14	administrations) and §58 (outcomes).
15	
16	DS-v1: marks carry the stack identity and a fresh mark identifier; the stack keeps the ordered list
17	of live marks; `rewind m` fails on a dead or foreign mark, rejects if an active authority derived
18	from `internal` covers a cell above `m`, otherwise returns those cells to available and removes `m`
19	and every mark above it; `push` and `grow` use the derived `issue` of Part XIV (`Arena.IssueD`: its
20	static checks, the availability `fail`, then `split` of `internal` and `store` of the block); `grow`
21	is in place only (same base, extension into the space directly after the block, `fail` otherwise).
22	
23	Every `ok` step of the library is a sequence of kernel steps O1–O16 (`DReach.reachable`), so the
24	abstraction adds no rights to the kernel (§36).
25	-/
26	
27	namespace Ern.Lib.DataStack
28	
29	open Ern.MemoryModel Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.MemoryModel.Arena
30	
31	/-! ## Library state (DS-v1; §38, §46, §47) -/
32	
33	/-- A block issued by a stack (DS-v1, non-normative; recorded like the issuances of §46): position
34	`base` of its first cell and number `size` of cells among the ordered cells of the stack, block
35	authority `auth`, destination `dst` that received it. -/
36	structure Blk where
37	  base : Nat
38	  size : Nat
39	  auth : Nat
40	  dst : Nat
41	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
42	
43	/-- A mark (DS-v1, non-normative: "marks carry stack identity and a fresh mark identifier";
44	library metadata of an administrative abstraction, §36, §38): the identity of its stack, its fresh
45	identifier, the top of the stack when it was taken. -/
46	structure Mark where
47	  stack : Nat
48	  id : Nat
49	  top : Nat
50	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
51	
52	/-- A stack (DS-v1, non-normative; library state, §38, §46): administered storage, `internal`
53	authority held by the stack value (§36), ordered cells (the leaves of the storage at creation),
54	top (the cells at positions `≥ top` are available), issued blocks (oldest first), and the ordered
55	list of live marks (DS-v1: "the stack keeps the ordered list of live marks"). -/
56	structure Stack where
57	  storage : Nat
58	  internal : Nat
59	  cells : List Nat
60	  top : Nat
61	  blocks : List Blk
62	  marks : List Mark
63	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
64	
65	/-- State of the stack library (DS-v1, non-normative; §38: administrative states of library
66	abstractions are separate from `S₃`): the kernel state, the stack registry (a stack is identified
67	by its index; stacks are never removed) and the next fresh mark identifier. -/
68	structure DState where
69	  kern : S3
70	  stacks : List Stack
71	  fresh : Nat
72	
73	/-- Initial state (§47: the kernel's initial state; the library registry starts empty; DS-v1,
74	non-normative: no mark identifier given out). -/
75	def DState.init (statics : Statics) : DState := ⟨S3.init statics, [], 0⟩
76	
77	/-- The `n` cells from position `b` of the stack, leaves of the administered storage (§46; DS-v1,
78	non-normative). -/
79	def cellsOf (st : Stack) (b n : Nat) : List Nat := (st.cells.drop b).take n
80	
81	/-- The cells above mark `m` (DS-v1, non-normative, "a cell above m"; reading recorded; §46
82	available leaves): the positions from the top of `m` to the current top, those that `rewind m`
83	returns to available. -/
84	def above (st : Stack) (m : Mark) : List Nat := cellsOf st m.top (st.top - m.top)
85	
86	/-- The stack seen as an administration entry (§46, §36; DS-v1, non-normative): storage,
87	`internal`, available cells (positions `≥ top`) and issued blocks. Used for `MetaRight` and the
88	static checks of the derived `issue`, which read only the storage and `internal`. -/
89	def Stack.entry (st : Stack) : ArenaEntry :=
90	  ⟨st.storage, st.internal, st.cells.drop st.top,
91	    st.blocks.map fun x => (cellsOf st x.base x.size, x.auth)⟩
92	
93	/-- The block of the stack whose authority is `b` (§46 issuances; DS-v1, non-normative). -/
94	def Stack.block (st : Stack) (b : Nat) : Option Blk := st.blocks.find? fun y => decide (y.auth = b)
95	
96	/-- A live mark of stack `j` (DS-v1, non-normative: a mark that is neither dead nor foreign; it
97	decides the `fail` case of `rewind`, §58): it names stack `j` and belongs to its list of live
98	marks. -/
99	def LiveMark (j : Nat) (st : Stack) (m : Mark) : Prop := m.stack = j ∧ m ∈ st.marks
100	
101	/-- Decidability of `LiveMark` (§58; DS-v1). -/
102	instance (j : Nat) (st : Stack) (m : Mark) : Decidable (LiveMark j st m) := by
103	  unfold LiveMark; infer_instance
104	
105	/-- The administrative right of §36 for a stack (DS-v1, non-normative, with §36 and §46 read for a
106	stack): the stack is live (`internal` is active) and `MetaRight`, `Modify` exercisable on the stack
107	value, the place holding `internal`. -/
108	def AdminRight (s : S3) (st : Stack) : Prop := s.Active st.internal ∧ MetaRight s st.entry
109	
110	/-- Decidability of `AdminRight` (§36; DS-v1). -/
111	instance (s : S3) (st : Stack) : Decidable (AdminRight s st) := by
112	  unfold AdminRight; infer_instance
113	
114	/-! ## `newStack` and the guard of §56 -/
115	
116	/-- The stack registry as a registry of live administrations (§56; DS-v1, non-normative): the
117	`internal` identities of its live stacks. -/
118	def stackInternals (s : S3) (stacks : List Stack) : List Nat :=
119	  (stacks.filter fun st => decide (s.Active st.internal)).map (·.internal)
120	
121	/-- Preconditions of `newStack(storage, internal)` (DS-v1, non-normative; §56): those of `newArena`
122	other than its guard (`NewArenaBase`, §76.1–§76.3 and §76.5 read for a stack), and the guard of §56
123	over the stack registry and every other registry of live administrations `others`. -/
124	structure NewStackPre (s : S3) (stacks : List Stack) (others : List (List Nat))
125	    (storage internal : Nat) : Prop where
126	  /-- §76.1–§76.3, §76.5, read for a stack (DS-v1). -/
127	  base : NewArenaBase s storage internal
128	  /-- §56: no live administration of any registry uses `internal`. -/
129	  guard : Guard56 (stackInternals s stacks :: others) internal
130	
131	/-- Decidability of `NewStackPre` (§56; DS-v1). -/
132	instance (s : S3) (stacks : List Stack) (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) :
133	    Decidable (NewStackPre s stacks others storage internal) :=
134	  decidable_of_iff (NewArenaBase s storage internal ∧
135	    Guard56 (stackInternals s stacks :: others) internal)
136	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩⟩
137	
138	/-- Effect of `newStack` (DS-v1, non-normative; §36: registration adds no rights): a stack whose
139	cells are the leaves of the storage, top 0, no block, no mark; the kernel state is unchanged. -/
140	def newStackEff (D : DState) (storage internal : Nat) : DState :=
141	  { D with stacks := D.stacks ++ [⟨storage, internal, footprint D.kern.P storage, 0, [], []⟩] }
142	
143	/-- `newStack` as a relation (DS-v1, non-normative; §56, §58): `ok` or `reject`. -/
144	def NewStackStep (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) (D : DState) :
145	    Outcome3 DState → Prop :=
146	  Guarded (NewStackPre D.kern D.stacks others storage internal) (newStackEff D storage internal)
147	
148	/-! ## `push` (DS-v1: the derived `issue`, Part XIV, §77) -/
149	
150	/-- Metadata after `push` (DS-v1, non-normative; as the `ok` effect of §77 on §46 metadata): the
151	cells leave the available part (the top rises by `size`), the block is recorded. -/
152	def pushMeta (st : Stack) (size a dst : Nat) : Stack :=
153	  { st with top := st.top + size, blocks := st.blocks ++ [⟨st.top, size, a, dst⟩] }
154	
155	/-- `push(j, size, dst)` (DS-v1, non-normative: "push uses the derived issue"): the derived `issue`
156	of Part XIV (`Arena.IssueD`) of the `size` cells at the top into `dst`, on the stack seen as an
157	entry: its static checks (`IssueStatic`, §77.1, §77.2, with `MetaRight` of §36), then `fail`, the
158	state unchanged, when fewer than `size` cells are left (availability, §77.4; reading recorded),
159	then `split` of `internal` on the cells (O2) and `store` of the block, of fresh identity `|A|`, into
160	`dst` (O8). -/
161	inductive PushStep (k : K) (j size dst : Nat) (D : DState) : Outcome3 DState → Prop where
162	  | noStack : D.stacks[j]? = none → PushStep k j size dst D .reject
163	  | static {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
164	      ¬ IssueStatic D.kern st.entry (cellsOf st st.top size) dst → PushStep k j size dst D .reject
165	  | fail {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
166	      IssueStatic D.kern st.entry (cellsOf st st.top size) dst →
167	      ¬ st.top + size ≤ st.cells.length → PushStep k j size dst D .fail
168	  | split {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
169	      IssueStatic D.kern st.entry (cellsOf st st.top size) dst →
170	      st.top + size ≤ st.cells.length →
171	      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st st.top size] D.kern .reject →
172	      PushStep k j size dst D .reject
173	  | store {st : Stack} {s₁ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
174	      IssueStatic D.kern st.entry (cellsOf st st.top size) dst →
175	      st.top + size ≤ st.cells.length →
176	      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st st.top size] D.kern (.ok s₁) →
177	      StoreStep D.kern.A.length dst s₁ .reject → PushStep k j size dst D .reject
178	  | ok {st : Stack} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
179	      IssueStatic D.kern st.entry (cellsOf st st.top size) dst →
180	      st.top + size ≤ st.cells.length →
181	      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st st.top size] D.kern (.ok s₁) →
182	      StoreStep D.kern.A.length dst s₁ (.ok s₂) →
183	      PushStep k j size dst D
184	        (.ok ⟨s₂, D.stacks.set j (pushMeta st size D.kern.A.length dst), D.fresh⟩)
185	
186	/-! ## `mark` (DS-v1) -/
187	
188	/-- Metadata after `mark` (DS-v1, non-normative; library metadata, §36, §38): a mark naming stack
189	`j`, with the fresh identifier `fresh` and the current top, is appended to the live marks. -/
190	def markMeta (j : Nat) (st : Stack) (fresh : Nat) : Stack :=
191	  { st with marks := st.marks ++ [⟨j, fresh, st.top⟩] }
192	
193	/-- `mark(j)` (DS-v1, non-normative; §58 outcomes; §36: metadata only, no right created): `ok`
194	on an existing stack; the identifier is fresh. -/
195	inductive MarkStep (j : Nat) (D : DState) : Outcome3 DState → Prop where
196	  | noStack : D.stacks[j]? = none → MarkStep j D .reject
197	  | ok {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
198	      MarkStep j D (.ok ⟨D.kern, D.stacks.set j (markMeta j st D.fresh), D.fresh + 1⟩)
199	
200	/-! ## `rewind` (DS-v1) -/
201	
202	/-- Metadata after `rewind m` (DS-v1, non-normative; as the `ok` effect of §78 on §46 metadata):
203	the cells above `m` return to available (the top returns to the top of `m`), the blocks from that
204	top are forgotten, `m` and every later mark are removed. -/
205	def rewindMeta (st : Stack) (m : Mark) : Stack :=
206	  { st with
207	    top := m.top
208	    blocks := st.blocks.filter fun x => decide (x.base < m.top)
209	    marks := st.marks.takeWhile fun x => decide (x ≠ m) }
210	
211	/-- `rewind(j, m)` (DS-v1, non-normative): `fail`, the state unchanged, on a dead or foreign mark;
212	`reject` without the administrative right of §36; then the derived `reset` of Part XIV on the cells
213	above `m` (reading recorded): `split` of `internal` on them (O2), which rejects when an active
214	authority derived from `internal` covers one of them (`rewind_rejects_live_above`), and `release`
215	of the derived authority (O3); `ok`: the cells return to available, `m` and the later marks are
216	removed. -/
217	inductive RewindStep (k : K) (j : Nat) (m : Mark) (D : DState) : Outcome3 DState → Prop where
218	  | noStack : D.stacks[j]? = none → RewindStep k j m D .reject
219	  | dead {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → ¬ LiveMark j st m → RewindStep k j m D .fail
220	  | static {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → LiveMark j st m → ¬ AdminRight D.kern st →
221	      RewindStep k j m D .reject
222	  | split {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → LiveMark j st m → AdminRight D.kern st →
223	      SplitStep k st.internal [above st m] D.kern .reject → RewindStep k j m D .reject
224	  | release {st : Stack} {s₁ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → LiveMark j st m →
225	      AdminRight D.kern st → SplitStep k st.internal [above st m] D.kern (.ok s₁) →
226	      ReleaseStep D.kern.A.length s₁ .reject → RewindStep k j m D .reject
227	  | ok {st : Stack} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → LiveMark j st m →
228	      AdminRight D.kern st → SplitStep k st.internal [above st m] D.kern (.ok s₁) →
229	      ReleaseStep D.kern.A.length s₁ (.ok s₂) →
230	      RewindStep k j m D (.ok ⟨s₂, D.stacks.set j (rewindMeta st m), D.fresh⟩)
231	
232	/-! ## `grow` (DS-v1: in place, the derived `issue`) -/
233	
234	/-- In-place extension (DS-v1, non-normative: "extension into the space directly after the
235	block"; the availability check of the derived `issue`, §77.4): the block ends at the top, and
236	`extra` available cells follow it. -/
237	def InPlace (st : Stack) (x : Blk) (extra : Nat) : Prop :=
238	  x.base + x.size = st.top ∧ st.top + extra ≤ st.cells.length
239	
240	/-- Decidability of `InPlace` (§77.4; DS-v1). -/
241	instance (st : Stack) (x : Blk) (extra : Nat) : Decidable (InPlace st x extra) := by
242	  unfold InPlace; infer_instance
243	
244	/-- The grown block (DS-v1, non-normative: same base, `extra` more cells, new authority `a`, same
245	destination; an issuance of §46). -/
246	def growBlk (x : Blk) (extra a : Nat) : Blk := ⟨x.base, x.size + extra, a, x.dst⟩
247	
248	/-- Metadata after `grow` (DS-v1, non-normative; as the `ok` effect of §77 on §46 metadata): the
249	top rises by `extra`; the block is replaced by the grown block. -/
250	def growMeta (st : Stack) (x : Blk) (extra a : Nat) : Stack :=
251	  { st with
252	    top := st.top + extra
253	    blocks := st.blocks.map fun y => if y.auth = x.auth then growBlk x extra a else y }
254	
255	/-- `grow(j, b, extra)` (DS-v1, non-normative: in place only, using the derived `issue`): `reject`
256	when `b` is not a block of the stack or `extra` is zero (reading recorded); `release` of `b` (O3);
257	then the derived `issue` of Part XIV (`Arena.IssueD`) of the region of the same base and of size
258	`size + extra` into the recorded destination, on the released state: its static checks
259	(`IssueStatic`, §77.1, §77.2), `fail`, the state unchanged, unless the extension is in place
260	(DS-v1 "fail otherwise", availability §77.4), `split` of `internal` (O2) and `store` of the new
261	block (O8). -/
262	inductive GrowStep (k : K) (j b extra : Nat) (D : DState) : Outcome3 DState → Prop where
263	  | noStack : D.stacks[j]? = none → GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
264	  | noBlock {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = none →
265	      GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
266	  | noExtra {st : Stack} {x : Blk} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x → extra = 0 →
267	      GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
268	  | release {st : Stack} {x : Blk} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x → 0 < extra →
269	      ReleaseStep b D.kern .reject → GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
270	  | static {st : Stack} {x : Blk} {s₁ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x →
271	      0 < extra → ReleaseStep b D.kern (.ok s₁) →
272	      ¬ IssueStatic s₁ st.entry (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) x.dst →
273	      GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
274	  | fail {st : Stack} {x : Blk} {s₁ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x →
275	      0 < extra → ReleaseStep b D.kern (.ok s₁) →
276	      IssueStatic s₁ st.entry (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) x.dst →
277	      ¬ InPlace st x extra → GrowStep k j b extra D .fail
278	  | split {st : Stack} {x : Blk} {s₁ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x →
279	      0 < extra → ReleaseStep b D.kern (.ok s₁) →
280	      IssueStatic s₁ st.entry (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) x.dst → InPlace st x extra →
281	      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)] s₁ .reject →
282	      GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
283	  | store {st : Stack} {x : Blk} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x →
284	      0 < extra → ReleaseStep b D.kern (.ok s₁) →
285	      IssueStatic s₁ st.entry (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) x.dst → InPlace st x extra →
286	      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)] s₁ (.ok s₂) →
287	      StoreStep s₁.A.length x.dst s₂ .reject → GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
288	  | ok {st : Stack} {x : Blk} {s₁ s₂ s₃ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x →
289	      0 < extra → ReleaseStep b D.kern (.ok s₁) →
290	      IssueStatic s₁ st.entry (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) x.dst → InPlace st x extra →
291	      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)] s₁ (.ok s₂) →
292	      StoreStep s₁.A.length x.dst s₂ (.ok s₃) →
293	      GrowStep k j b extra D (.ok ⟨s₃, D.stacks.set j (growMeta st x extra s₁.A.length), D.fresh⟩)
294	
295	/-! ## Library runs (DS-v1; §36, §56, §57) -/
296	
297	/-- One `ok` step of the stack library (DS-v1, non-normative): a kernel step O1–O16 of
298	non-administrative code, the registry unchanged; `newStack` with the guard of §56 against the other
299	registries `others`; `push`, `mark`, `rewind`, `grow`. -/
300	inductive DStep (k : K) : DState → DState → Prop where
301	  | kernel {D : DState} {s' : S3} : KStep k D.kern s' → DStep k D ⟨s', D.stacks, D.fresh⟩
302	  | newStack {D D' : DState} {others : List (List Nat)} {storage i : Nat} :
303	      NewStackStep others storage i D (.ok D') → DStep k D D'
304	  | push {D D' : DState} {j size dst : Nat} : PushStep k j size dst D (.ok D') → DStep k D D'
305	  | mark {D D' : DState} {j : Nat} : MarkStep j D (.ok D') → DStep k D D'
306	  | rewind {D D' : DState} {j : Nat} {m : Mark} : RewindStep k j m D (.ok D') → DStep k D D'
307	  | grow {D D' : DState} {j b extra : Nat} : GrowStep k j b extra D (.ok D') → DStep k D D'
308	
309	/-- States reachable from the initial state by library steps (DS-v1, non-normative; §47). -/
310	inductive DReach (k : K) (statics : Statics) : DState → Prop where
311	  | init : DReach k statics (DState.init statics)
312	  | step {D D' : DState} : DReach k statics D → DStep k D D' → DReach k statics D'
313	
314	/-- Finite sequences of library steps (DS-v1, non-normative; §58 `ok` transitions). -/
315	inductive DRun (k : K) : DState → DState → Prop where
316	  | refl (D : DState) : DRun k D D
317	  | tail {D D' D'' : DState} : DRun k D D' → DStep k D' D'' → DRun k D D''
318	
319	/-- The kernel part of a library step is reached by kernel steps (§36: the abstraction adds no
320	rights to the kernel; Part XIV: `issue` is `split` then `store`, the reset part of `rewind` is
321	`split` then `release`; DS-v1). -/
322	theorem DStep.reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {D D' : DState}
323	    (hr : Reachable k statics D.kern) (h : DStep k D D') : Reachable k statics D'.kern := by
324	  cases h with
325	  | kernel hk => exact .step hr hk
326	  | newStack hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact hr
327	  | push hs =>
328	    cases hs with
329	    | ok _ _ _ hsp hst => exact .step (.step hr (.split hsp)) (.store hst)
330	  | mark hs => cases hs with | ok _ => exact hr
331	  | rewind hs =>
332	    cases hs with
333	    | ok _ _ _ hsp hrl => exact .step (.step hr (.split hsp)) (.release hrl)
334	  | grow hs =>
335	    cases hs with
336	    | ok _ _ _ hrl _ _ hsp hst =>
337	      exact .step (.step (.step hr (.release hrl)) (.split hsp)) (.store hst)
338	
339	/-- The kernel state of every library-reachable state is kernel-reachable (§36, §57; DS-v1). -/
340	theorem DReach.reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {D : DState} (h : DReach k statics D) :
341	    Reachable k statics D.kern := by
342	  induction h with
343	  | init => exact .init
344	  | step _ hs ih => exact hs.reachable ih
345	
346	/-! ## Helper lemmas (lists, kernel effects) -/
347	
348	/-- Reading a list after `set` (support for the §46 metadata updates of DS-v1). -/
349	theorem getElem?_set_cases {α : Type} {l : List α} {j i : Nat} {v x : α}
350	    (h : (l.set j v)[i]? = some x) : (i = j ∧ x = v) ∨ (i ≠ j ∧ l[i]? = some x) := by
351	  rw [List.getElem?_set] at h
352	  by_cases hij : j = i
353	  · subst hij; simp only [↓reduceIte] at h; split at h
354	    · cases h; exact .inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
355	    · cases h
356	  · simp only [hij, ↓reduceIte] at h; exact .inr ⟨Ne.symm hij, h⟩
357	
358	/-- Reading a list after appending one element (support for the §46 metadata updates of
359	DS-v1). -/
360	theorem getElem?_append_single {α : Type} {l : List α} {x y : α} {i : Nat}
361	    (h : (l ++ [x])[i]? = some y) : l[i]? = some y ∨ y = x := by
362	  rw [List.getElem?_append] at h
363	  split at h
364	  · exact .inl h
365	  · cases hc : i - l.length with

507	  | kernel => exact hw
508	  | newStack hs =>
509	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
510	    intro i st h
511	    rcases getElem?_append_single h with h | rfl
512	    · exact hw i st h
513	    · exact ⟨List.nodup_nil, fun m hm => by simp at hm⟩

515	    cases hs with
516	    | ok hst => exact marksWF_set hw hst rfl (List.Sublist.refl _) (Nat.le_refl _)

518	    cases hs with
519	    | ok hst => exact marksWF_set hw hst rfl (List.takeWhile_sublist _) (Nat.le_refl _)

O1 derive (§60): takes a region (List Nat, read extensionally), not a place. Preconditions: active source; ExercisableAt source mode; every leaf of region exists, is a leaf, belongs to afp source; mode ≤ effective mode of source on each leaf; §60.3 as a decidable clause (no unrelated active authority becomes incompatible); §60.4 current frame live. §60.1c "origin chain and anchors valid" and §60.4b "footprint and anchoring restrictions": no checkable content -> omitted, recorded.
O2 split (§61): draft clauses (incl. no exclusive right already distributed). §61.4 is NOT a precondition (the §61 note says an accepted split may violate I1 without DDSound) -> recorded.
O3 release (§62): draft clauses; §62.5 (abstraction contracts) omitted, recorded.
O4 transfer (§63): draft clauses MINUS the draft's extra clause "(transferEff s src dst).Usable dst" (not in §63); PLUS §63.8 (local self-blocking prevention, as LockOptions.Opt2Transfer on formal/derivability_0.1); effect: dependencies follow the corresponding places corr(r) (not all to the destination root); §63.6 over moved usable places and AnchorOrder in the resulting state; §63.7 AnchorOrderHeld for the moved held authorities in the resulting state; §63.4 = draft ActiveDerivedOutside reading (recorded); §63.2 child order = place index order (recorded).
O5 depend (§64): draft clauses; §64.2b "real dependency" omitted, recorded.
O8 store (§65): draft clauses (they match).
O9/O10/O11 (§66–§68): add "every leaf belongs to a usable place" (§66.1, §67.1, §68.1); O10 keeps §67.2 explicitly.
O12 endUse (§69): death markers transitive over owned storage; drop the draft's extra disjunct that blocks descendants of authorities the step releases (not in §69.2) -> record the consequence.
O13 free (§70): death markers transitive; no extra "Usable p" and no clearing of D beyond what §70 prescribes; §70.4 scope = the released unit (place and storage that dies with it).
O14 alloc (§71): shape nonempty with exactly ONE root (one new storage root), parts' parents inside the shape, no owner component; provider clause as written in §71.2 (Modify OR writeShared over SharedMutable metadata) -> conflict with §36 recorded; outcomes reject / fail (not Satisfiable) / ok.
O6 enterFrame (§72): locals owned directly by the new frame (no local owned by another local); §72.3 ParamOriginHidden; §72.4 AnchorOrderHeld in the resulting state.
O7 exitFrame (§73): draft (first surviving active origin, held by a frame or a usable place).
O15/O16 pin/unpin (§74, §75): per-leaf dynamic pin flags (draft); unpin requires the place usable and K.ExternalDone(place) on the place; StaticPinnedBottom is a condition on (K, statics), not on states.
HasRight / ExercisableAt (§43): one authority exercisable at m with sufficient effective mode on every leaf (∃ a, ∀ l) as the draft -> recorded.
WF3 (§49): a structure with eight named fields, one per item:
 1 frames: F nonempty, no duplicates, every frame < nF;
 2 places: parent links valid and acyclic (representation: parent index < child index), parts share the owner and death marker of their parent;
 3 owners: owner frames < nF, owner places exist; "well-founded ownership chains reaching a live frame for every usable place" read as stated for usable places (Usable is inductive) -> recorded with the global-acyclicity alternative;
 4 footprints: every footprint member is an existing leaf;
 5 authorities: origins exist and precede (origin index < id: representation of acyclic chains ending at a root);
 6 RootChain (draft);
 7 RootHeld as §49.7 states it: every usable root place has an active root authority, Modify, no origin, held by its owner, whose footprint is the place's footprint (draft RootLive + mode);
 8 holder validity (draft poss).
 The draft's converse RootHeld (every origin-less authority covering a leaf of root r is held by r's owner) is NOT a WF3 clause: keep it as a separate auxiliary predicate.
I2 (§51): mode conservation unconditional (not under ∀ p ∈ footprint).
Initial state (§47): base frame 0; statics may be owned by statics; root authority held by the owner. Well-formedness of the statics declaration (acyclic ownership, parents before children) is not stated by §47: keep the draft ShapeOK-style hypothesis as a hypothesis of the init theorems and record it as a spec gap.
Reachable: closure of S3.init statics under the kernel steps O1–O16 only.

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Basic

/-!
# Access kernel: operations O1–O16

The sixteen kernel operations of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.md` §60–§75. Each
operation has a precondition structure with one named field per clause item (or per condition of
an item), each field citing its clause; a `Decidable` instance; an effect function; and a step
relation over `Outcome3` (§58). Every operation except `alloc` is `Guarded` (`ok` or `reject`);
`alloc` may also `fail` (§58, §71). `KStep` is the union of their `ok` transitions.
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-- `mapI f i l` applies `f` to each element of `l` with its index counted from `i` (used by the
effects of §72 and §73). -/
def mapI {α β : Type} (f : Nat → α → β) : Nat → List α → List β
  | _, [] => []
  | i, a :: l => f i a :: mapI f (i + 1) l

/-! ## O1 `derive` (§60) -/

/-- Effect of `derive(source, region, mode)` (§60, `ok` effect): a new active authority of fresh
identity, origin `src`, mode `m`, footprint `region`, held by the current frame. -/
def deriveEff (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) : S3 :=
  s.addAuth ⟨m, some src, region, .frame s.top, true⟩

/-- Preconditions of `derive` (§60). -/
structure DerivePre (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) : Prop where
  /-- §60.1: `source` is active. -/
  active : s.Active src
  /-- §60.1: `ExercisableAt(s, source, mode)`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt src m
  /-- §60.2: the leaves of `region` exist. -/
  leaves : ∀ l ∈ region, l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l
  /-- §60.2: the leaves of `region` belong to the footprint of `source`. -/
  within : ∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ s.afp src
  /-- §60.2: `mode` does not exceed the effective right of `source` on these leaves. -/
  modeOK : ∀ l ∈ region, Allows (effective s src l) m
  /-- §60.3: the addition preserves I1 (§50): an active authority outside the origin chain of the
  new one and sharing a leaf of `region` has own mode `Observe`, and so has the request. -/
  exclusive : ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
    b ∉ src :: s.ancs src → (∃ l ∈ region, l ∈ y.footprint) → y.mode = .observe ∧ m = .observe)
    True
  /-- §60.4: the new holding frame is the live current frame. -/
  frameLive : s.top ∈ s.F

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `derive` (§60). -/
instance (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) :
    Decidable (DerivePre s src region m) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Active src ∧ s.ExercisableAt src m ∧
    (∀ l ∈ region, l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l) ∧ (∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ s.afp src) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ region, Allows (effective s src l) m) ∧
    (∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
      b ∉ src :: s.ancs src → (∃ l ∈ region, l ∈ y.footprint) → y.mode = .observe ∧ m = .observe)
      True) ∧
    s.top ∈ s.F)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩⟩

/-- `derive` as a relation (§60). -/
def DeriveStep (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (DerivePre s src region m) (deriveEff s src region m)

/-! ## O2 `split` (§61) -/

/-- Effect of `split(source, regions)` (§61, `ok` effect): one active derived `Modify` authority
per region, held by the current frame. -/
def splitEff (s : S3) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) : S3 :=
  { s with A := s.A ++ rs.map fun r => ⟨.modify, some src, r, .frame s.top, true⟩ }

/-- Exclusive right already distributed by `src` on leaf `p` (§61.3): an active `Modify`
descendant of `src` covering `p`. -/
def DistribExcl (s : S3) (src j p : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ src ∈ s.ancs j ∧ p ∈ y.footprint ∧ y.mode = .modify)
    False

/-- Decidability of `DistribExcl` (§61.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (src j p : Nat) : Decidable (DistribExcl s src j p) := by
  unfold DistribExcl; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `split` (§61). §61.4 is not a precondition (see the note of §61). -/
structure SplitPre (k : K) (s : S3) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) : Prop where
  /-- §61.1: `source` is active. -/
  active : s.Active src
  /-- §61.1: `source` is exercisable by the current frame in `Modify`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt src .modify
  /-- §61.1: sufficient modification rights: effective `Modify` on every leaf of the regions. -/
  modifyOn : ∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, effective s src p = some .modify
  /-- §61.2: each region lies within the available footprint of `source`. -/
  within : ∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, p ∈ s.afp src ∧ effective s src p ≠ none
  /-- §61.3: regions are pairwise disjoint, structurally or by `K.DeclaredDisjoint`. -/
  disjoint : rs.Pairwise (fun r r' => (∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r') ∨ k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')
  /-- §61.3: no exclusive right already distributed is overlapped. -/
  notDistributed : ∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ DistribExcl s src j p

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `split` (§61). -/
instance (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] (s : S3) (src : Nat)
    (rs : List (List Nat)) : Decidable (SplitPre k s src rs) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Active src ∧ s.ExercisableAt src .modify ∧
    (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, effective s src p = some .modify) ∧
    (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, p ∈ s.afp src ∧ effective s src p ≠ none) ∧
    rs.Pairwise (fun r r' => (∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r') ∨ k.DeclaredDisjoint r r') ∧
    (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ DistribExcl s src j p))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩⟩

/-- `split` as a relation (§61). -/
def SplitStep (k : K) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (SplitPre k s src rs) (splitEff s src rs)

/-! ## O3 `release` (§62) -/

/-- Effect of `release(authority)` (§62, `ok` effect): the authority becomes inactive and leaves
the anchors of its holding place. -/
def releaseEff (s : S3) (a : Nat) : S3 := match s.A[a]? with
  | some x => { s with
      A := s.A.set a { x with active := false }
      D := fun q => if x.holder = .place q then (s.D q).filter (· != a) else s.D q }
  | none => s

/-- Right of the current frame on a holder (§62.2): the current frame itself, or a place on which
the current frame has exercisable `Modify`. -/
def HolderRight (s : S3) : Holder → Prop
  | .frame f => f = s.top
  | .place p => HasRight s .modify p

/-- Decidability of `HolderRight` (§62.2). -/
instance (s : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (HolderRight s h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold HolderRight <;> infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `release` (§62). §62.5 is not represented. -/
structure ReleasePre (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §62.1: the authority is active. -/
  active : s.Active a
  /-- §62.1: the authority is derived. -/
  derived : OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none) False
  /-- §62.2: it is held by the current frame or by a place with exercisable `Modify`. -/
  holderRight : OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => HolderRight s y.holder) False
  /-- §62.3: no active descendant. -/
  noActiveDesc : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j
  /-- §62.3, §62.4: no usable place keeps `a` as anchor, except its holding place. -/
  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → a ∈ s.D q →
    (s.A[a]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place q)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `release` (§62). -/
instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Decidable (ReleasePre s a) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Active a ∧ OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none) False ∧
    OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => HolderRight s y.holder) False ∧
    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j) ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → a ∈ s.D q →
      (s.A[a]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place q)))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- `release` as a relation (§62). -/
def ReleaseStep (a : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (ReleasePre s a) (releaseEff s a)

/-! ## O4 `transfer` (§63) -/

/-- Children of place `x` in index order (§63.2). -/
def kids (P : List Place) (x : Nat) : List Nat :=
  (List.range P.length).filter fun r => decide (parentOf P r = some x)

/-- Position of `r` in a list, its length if absent (§63.2). -/
def posIn (r : Nat) : List Nat → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | a :: l => if a = r then 0 else posIn r l + 1

/-- `corr(r)` within `n` steps (§63.2): `dst` for `src`; for another part, the child at the same
position of the place corresponding to its parent. -/
